modes.direct-cold: fixed direct route, rebuild only requested derived body each request
modes.ignition-cold: generic relevance/dependency route, rebuild requested body each request
modes.ignition-warm: generic route with persistent state-bound materialization cache
modes.eager-warm: materialize full capability body once and retain it

measurements.interpretation: Honest no-memory-advantage case. All seven bodies are relevant. Eager-warm was slightly faster in this hosted sample; timing is observational, not statistically established.
Ignition begins narrow but eventually touches all bodies; its retained cache therefore converges to eager size.

strongestSupportedClaim: A state-bound warm materialization cache can eliminate repeated derived-state rebuilds while preserving exact results. Its retained-memory advantage exists only while the touched capability set remains narrower than the full body; when all capabilities become relevant, cache size converges to eager and orchestration can be neutral or slightly slower.
boundaries: Single hosted-run timings are observations, not a statistical performance distribution.
Does not prove free compute, created RAM, or free energy.
Does not prove optimal cache eviction or mutation handling beyond full state-hash invalidation.
Does not prove warm-cache superiority when the entire body is routinely required.
nextGate: Add adaptive cache policy and request-breadth selection: choose direct, cold Ignition, warm Ignition, or eager retention from measured reuse/breadth/resource conditions instead of assuming one mode is universally best.
